simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3603, bypasses the EuP standby-on-AC-power-up flag ($fp = 0xDEADBEAD in M3602.start()), starts the SEE program at 0xA6000200, initializes the Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x63 (tuners.py, device.tunerModel), and opens its main menu OSD (~1,544 unique colours at 80 M instructions, panel " ON ", "noCH").

desc: The 1.24C PVR patch release (2012-09-06) for the Opticum HD X110p satellite receiver on the ALi M3606 SoC (bootloader DVBS2---0.1.1, Libcore 7.2.0).

Like the 1.0.11C build, its NIM attach pairs the internal S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator with an Airoha AV2011 silicon tuner at 7-bit I2C address 0x63 on SCB0 and verifies that the AV2011 acknowledges a register write at startup before opening the main menu.
